correctness.rationale: The source defines Musin A_k(1,2) via the first maximizer of reference secants for F(u)=exp(u^2), rho=sigma/n and u=loglog n, reference n=55440. Independently recomputing Alaoglu–Erdos critical increments using high-precision mpmath gave 56 strict events to cutoff eps(167,1), 42 candidates below 10^65, classical index 15 n=6983776800 with J17 approximately 173,611,222 versus nearest 170,810,097, and index 10 n=720720 maximizes J16. Independently evaluating Robin tail B(5) gave about 295,370 (<300000), and derivative log upper numerator <17/u vs denominator >2u for u>=5 proves no larger contact. Inspected original artifacts/verify.py for directed Decimal outward intervals and primorial exhaustive finite-cover logic. Mathematical claim is only first transition at k17, with k<=16 plateau imported from source, not higher jumps.
